verdict.rationale: Svelte's compiler turns components into lean, tightly optimized JavaScript that does minimal work in the browser, and a community report describes a large bundle-size improvement after migrating from React. That supports the small-bundle, low-runtime-footprint part of the story. Nothing in the pack addresses dependency count or supply-chain risk. Missing for 10: evidence of a dependency-light runtime or reduced dependency tree, supply-chain risk claims or documentation, and concrete bundle-size figures or benchmarks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship a small, dependency-light client bundle to minimize runtime footprint and reduce supply-chain risk

citations.quote: It uses a compiler to turn declarative components written in HTML, CSS and JavaScript...into lean, tightly optimized JavaScript.
a UI framework that uses a compiler to let you write breathtakingly concise components that do minimal work in the browser
the difference was 'night and day' in performance, bundle size and dev productivity.
